2124146500175368254.en_summary: Simply: a vol $VIX spike = spring compresses. FAST vol collapse = spring snaps. Only a FAST snap is a good buy signal. The speed of the vol collapse back from high vol matters, not just that it falls. A spike by itself just tells you fear is rising. It tells you nothing about whether the fuel will be released fast enough to matter. Fast vol collapse forces concentrated Delta buybacks creating sharp bottoms; slow decline spreads buying with no pop.
2124146500175368254.zh_summary: 簡單來說：波動率 $VIX 飆升等於彈簧壓縮。波動率快速回落等於彈簧反彈。只有快速反彈才是良好買入訊號。波動率從高位回落的速度很重要，而不僅僅是下跌。單獨的飆升只表明恐懼上升，但沒有說明燃料是否會快速釋放。快速波動率回落迫使集中的Delta回補買入，創造尖銳底部；緩慢下降則將買入分散，沒有彈力。
